name: audit_orchestrator
description: Autonomous Multi-Agent Compliance Mesh for automated EU AI Act and GDPR audits on Google Cloud Platform

runtime.isolation: VPC Service Controls & Cloud KMS CMEK

extensions.description: Ability to use the ADK 2.0 agent executor implementation

skills.name: model
skills.description: Root orchestrator agent coordinating specialized sub-agents

skills.name: parse_terraform_iac
skills.description: Parses and performs static compliance audit on Terraform IaC files (.tf). Identifies security vulnerabilities and regulatory non-compliance under EU AI Act and GDPR.

skills.name: parse_python_source
skills.description: Parses and performs AST static compliance audit on Python source files (.py). Detects hardcoded secrets, unencrypted disk storage of PII (GDPR), and unmonitored AI models (EU AI Act).

skills.name: query_regulatory_rag
skills.description: Queries official EU AI Act and GDPR vector store in AlloyDB pgvector for regulatory articles, recitals, and legal context.

skills.name: generate_madr_adr
skills.description: Generates an Architecture Decision Record conforming strictly to the English MADR v3 standard.

skills.name: submit_hitl_remediation_review
skills.description: Prepares, commits, pushes a Human-in-the-Loop GitOps PR package with applied patch diff to target files and opens a real GitHub Draft PR.
